title: retro-style theme pack
description: themes/<id>/theme.json. The rules behind each field are in docs/THEME_SPEC.md; tools/theme_tool.py check enforces them.

id.description: Same as the folder name. Used in overlay package names and settings.

summary.description: One sentence shown under the name.

category.description: Settings group: today's Android, a past Android release, or a ROM or community classic.

order.description: Sort position inside the category (lower first).

source.description: wallpaper keeps the user's Material You colors; preset uses seed.

seed.description: Monet seed color. Every system color is derived from it.

style.description: How Monet turns the seed into palettes.

night.description: Force dark or light mode while the pack is on; system leaves the user's choice.

black.description: Pure black dark backgrounds (LineageOS Black theme). Needs night dark or system.

font.description: System font families for body and headline text.

widgets.description: Framework widget family: today's, Holo (3.0 to 4.4), classic (1.0 to 2.3) or Material 1 (5.0 to 9).

corner.description: Corner radius of dialogs, buttons, cards, notifications, Quick Settings and the shade.

shell.description: SystemUI and Launcher3 behavior from the retro-style patches.

skin.description: Shade skin: stock Android 16 or the KitKat tablet panels.

accent.description: Clock and tile highlight of the kitkat skin.

layout.description: Bottom bar the pack suggests as a build default.

bar_apps.description: Default for app icons on the system bar.

bar_home.description: Default system bar background on the home screen (leave it out for the launcher's own).
